label: Scorpion-Empress first encounter

purpose.value: Before the hatchery tunnels of her peaceful desert civilization, the matriarch raises her pincers in a containment posture and issues the law's fair warning; the hero hears every word and misreads a mother shielding nurseries as the last dread sovereign. The guardian attempts communication first; the hero misreads it as a villain's taunt.

emotionalProgression.note: The guardian announces itself and its duty plainly, framed by the hatchery tunnels.
The warning was honest and complete; being ignored reads as insult.

notes: The scene MUST establish the guardian announcing itself and warning honestly — the law of fair warning means its attack paths will be shown, not hidden. The mercy exit (withdraw) is offered and never taken. Flavor: the hatchery tunnels. The player's view may hint the guardian's true role; the hero must not perceive it. The Empress never reveals the reception hall behind her — it is her secret.
